name: mediajoiner-pro
description: Video & Audio Joiner, Timeline Alignment & Hardware-Accelerated Compressor per macOS

scripts.build:app: npx electron-packager . "MediaJoiner Pro" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --icon=assets/icon --overwrite --app-bundle-id=com.muccio.mediajoinerpro --app-category-type=public.app-category.video --prune=true && cp assets/icon.icns "dist/MediaJoiner Pro-darwin-arm64/MediaJoiner Pro.app/Contents/Resources/electron.icns"
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:app && hdiutil create -volname "MediaJoiner Pro" -srcfolder "dist/MediaJoiner Pro-darwin-arm64/MediaJoiner Pro.app" -ov -format UDZO "dist/MediaJoiner-Pro-1.1.0-arm64.dmg" && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "dist/MediaJoiner Pro-darwin-arm64/MediaJoiner Pro.app" "dist/MediaJoiner-Pro-1.1.0-mac-arm64.zip"

author: Mario Salvucci
